title: Stage 3 Output Bundle
description: All export artifacts generated from the Stage 2 architecture spec. Stage 3 of the Speakspec pipeline. agents_md is the hero artifact and is hard-capped at 200 lines by a downstream quality gate. Mermaid diagrams are raw source; the validate-and-repair loop runs AFTER this schema is produced.

agents_md.description: The primary agent context file. Lean, command-first, under 200 lines. FIXED section order: (1) one-line project description, (2) tech stack with exact versions, (3) exact commands build/test/lint/run/deploy, (4) 3-5 key directories with one-line descriptions and file pointers, (5) hard constraints, (6) do-not block, (7) first tasks in build order, (8) open questions. No prose descriptions of files that appear in the file tree. No restating what a linter/compiler enforces.

claude_md_shim.description: Claude Code compatibility shim. Contains '@AGENTS.md' and nothing else unless a genuine Claude-Code-specific override is required.

adrs.description: One MADR-format ADR per architecture_decision in Stage 2. Order matches Stage 2 decision order.

markdown.description: MADR body with sections in order: Status (always 'Proposed'), Context, Decision, Confidence, Consequences, Alternatives considered.

diagrams.description: Raw Mermaid source for each diagram type. Theme-neutral: NO custom theme/init directives. Each must be valid Mermaid 11 syntax. Avoid unescaped parentheses/quotes inside node labels and fullwidth/Chinese punctuation.

er.description: erDiagram: data model entities, fields, types, relationships.

component.description: graph TD: internal component boundaries and data flow.

c4_context.description: C4Context: system, its users, and all external systems named in the spec.

c4_container.description: C4Container: major deployable units and their communication paths.

file_tree.description: Suggested directory structure as a monospace tree. Every non-obvious file has an inline comment. Matches the recommended stack's conventions.

scope.description: Skeleton only. No business logic. Produces a compiling skeleton when executed.
